Iris (Growth): CTAs: Instant -> "Measure 99th latency"; Cost -> "Estimate $/1k calls"; Enterprise -> "Request SLA quote". I'll wire landing pages and UTM tags.

AJ (Sales): Sales snippets need a one-line benefit + quick objection response per angle, and a curl demo for field techs.
Maya (Mktg): Draft hero: "Latency where users notice it. Cost where teams optimize it. Redwood helps you balance both across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Thoughts?
Sam (Prod): Add a short technical callout: "Prefix & KV caching cut tail latency; smart routing provides graceful fallbacks to compatible variants under load." Good trust signal.
Iris (Growth): Let's A/B test hero emotional vs numbers-first (99th + $/1k). Also test CTA phrasing. I'll set up the matrix.
Leo (Design): For the webinar, animate a "batching slider" to show how batching reduces $/token but nudges tail latency. That visual lands well.
